ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the image is an acetate fragment labeled AcO, and it carries a negative charge; on the right side is an acetyl carbonyl structure, where the carbonyl carbon is connected to an oxygen atom, and that oxygen is further connected to PPh3, with the phosphorus center carrying a positive charge. There are also multiple curved arrows in the image, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: The left AcO− expands to acetate, whose SMILES is CC(=O)[O-]. The structure on the right is an acetyloxytriphenylphosphonium fragment, which can be written as CC(=O)O[P+](Ph)(Ph)Ph; replacing each Ph with the phenyl SMILES c1ccccc1 gives CC(=O)O[P+](c1ccccc1)(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1. The two fragments are not bonded to each other, so they are connected with a period.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the separate AcO− species on the left and the acyl-O-PPh3 species on the right, disregarding all curved arrows as instructed. Expand AcO− to acetate, CC(=O)[O-]. Expand the right-hand acetyl carbonyl connected to oxygen-phosphonium-triphenyl group as CC(=O)O[P+](Ph)(Ph)Ph, then replace each Ph with c1ccccc1. Combine the two disconnected components with a period to obtain the full SMILES.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是标为 AcO 的乙酸根片段，并带有负电荷；右侧是一个乙酰羰基结构，羰基碳连接到一个氧原子，该氧再连接到 PPh3，磷中心带正电荷。图中还有多条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：左侧 AcO− 展开为乙酸根，其 SMILES 为 CC(=O)[O-]。右侧结构是乙酰氧基三苯基膦鎓片段，可写为 CC(=O)O[P+](Ph)(Ph)Ph；将每个 Ph 替换为苯基 SMILES c1ccccc1，得到 CC(=O)O[P+](c1ccccc1)(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1。两个片段彼此不成键，因此用句点连接。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as containing two disconnected molecular components while ignoring curved arrows: a left acetate anion labeled AcO−, and an acyl oxyphosphonium fragment with an acetyl carbonyl group bonded through oxygen to PPh3, with phosphorus bearing a positive charge. The image also shows three phenyl groups abbreviated as Ph3 on phosphorus.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use chemical abbreviations and SMILES rules: Ac means CH3C(=O)–, AcO− as acetate is CC(=O)[O-], Ph is c1ccccc1, and a positively charged phosphonium center bonded to O and three phenyl groups is written [P+](c1ccccc1)(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1. Separate disconnected species with a dot.
